historical_references.reference:
Dheerandra was a famous Jain monk and philosopher from the 12th century. He is considered one of the greatest scholars of Jainism and is known for his commentaries on various Jain texts. He was a disciple of Hemachandra, the founder of the Digambara Terapanth sect of Jainism.
Time Period: 1178 - 1271 AD
Context: Jainism, Philosophy, Scholarship

Dheerandra was also a renowned poet and wrote numerous works in Sanskrit, Prakrit and Apabhramsha languages. His works include commentaries on the Agama texts, collections of stories and hymns, and a treatise on the nature of the self. He is considered the last great Jain poet in Kannada literature.
Time Period: 12th - 13th century AD
Context: Jainism, Literature, Poetry
